title: Reference-app First‑Run Gallery and README Flow Diagrams for Quickstart
creator: Aisha Bhandari
description:
Goal: Produce a compact set of visual assets (reference app screenshots, annotated first-run flows, and README diagrams) that make the Template Apps quickstart feel immediately achievable for engineers trying Redwood for the first time. Deliverables should be optimized for the docs site, README embeds, and in-console quickstart cards.

Scope:
- Capture 6 canonical screenshots of the Reference App (First-run, Connect API key, Run a prompt, Streaming response, Cost & latency card, Rollout toggle).
- Create 2 README diagrams: a high-level first-run flow (SVG) and a smaller amplification diagram showing credential & region considerations.
- Produce 3 export sizes for screenshots (1200x700 hero, 800x450 inline, 400x225 thumbnail) with 2x retina variants.
- Provide a short copy bundle for each image (alt text, caption, copy for README snippet).

Acceptance criteria:
- All screenshots match visual spec (Figma file ref below) and use the standardized frame + annotations.
- README SVGs are crisp at 2x and include accessible color contrast.
- Assets are uploaded to Drive and linked in PR; filenames follow naming convention: refapp_firstrun_<screen>_1x.png / refapp_firstrun_<screen>_2x.png / refapp_flow.svg.
- PM sign-off on captions and diagram sequencing.

Design notes:
- Use the new console palette for annotations (Azure-600 for highlights, Charcoal-700 for text overlays).
- Prefer simplified overlays rather than cropped UI to keep screenshots stable across minor UI tweaks.
- Keep microcopy friction-free: prefer "Run" over "Execute"; show example prompt that demonstrates streaming tokens.

Non-goals: Localization of copy (will be separate ticket), motion gifs (deferred).
